## Specification

### Component: Separator

A quiet line between groups, optionally with a centred label. Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
- `<div class="ui-separator" data-orientation="horizontal|vertical" role="none|separator">`.
- Labelled: `<div class="ui-separator ui-separator-label"><span class="ui-separator-text">or</span></div>` (a line on both sides via `::before/::after`).

#### Props
- `orientation`: `horizontal` (default) | `vertical`. `decorative` (default true gives `role="none"`; false gives `role="separator"` plus `aria-orientation` when vertical). `children`: label.

#### Visual rules
- 1px in `--ui-border`. Horizontal: full width. Vertical: `align-self: stretch`, min-height 16px, so the parent needs a height.
- Label: 12px/500, uppercase, letter-spacing .04em, `--ui-muted-foreground`, gap 12px.

#### Accessibility
- Decorative by default; use `decorative={false}` only for a meaningful thematic break.

#### Acceptance checks
- Horizontal is 1px tall; vertical is 1px wide and as tall as its row; the label sits between two lines.

### `ui/components/separator/separator.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export interface SeparatorProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Direction of the line. Default `horizontal`. A vertical one needs a parent with a height (e.g. `h-4` in a flex row). */
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
  /**
   * `true` (default): purely visual, hidden from assistive tech (`role="none"`).
   * `false`: a real thematic break (`role="separator"`) announced by screen readers.
   */
  decorative?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Separator — a quiet line between groups. With `children` it becomes a
 * labelled divider ("or") with the line on both sides. Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Separator = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SeparatorProps>(function Separator(
  { orientation = 'horizontal', decorative = true, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const a11y = decorative
    ? { role: 'none' as const }
    : { role: 'separator' as const, 'aria-orientation': orientation === 'vertical' ? ('vertical' as const) : undefined };
  const hasLabel = children !== undefined && children !== null && children !== false;
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      data-orientation={orientation}
      className={cn('ui-separator', hasLabel && 'ui-separator-label', className)}
      {...a11y}
      {...props}
    >
      {hasLabel && <span className="ui-separator-text">{children}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/separator.css`

```css
/* Separator ---------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-separator" role="none" data-orientation="horizontal">
   <div class="ui-separator" data-orientation="vertical">   (give the parent a height)
   Labelled: <div class="ui-separator ui-separator-label"><span class="ui-separator-text">or</span></div>
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-separator {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background-color: var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-separator[data-orientation="horizontal"] { width: 100%; height: 1px; }
  .ui-separator[data-orientation="vertical"] { align-self: stretch; width: 1px; min-height: 1rem; height: auto; }

  /* Labelled: the line is drawn either side of the text */
  .ui-separator-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    height: auto;
    background: none;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .ui-separator-label::before,
  .ui-separator-label::after {
    content: "";
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background-color: var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-separator-label > .ui-separator-text { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-separator-label[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; width: auto; height: 100%; }
  .ui-separator-label[data-orientation="vertical"]::before,
  .ui-separator-label[data-orientation="vertical"]::after { width: 1px; height: auto; }
}
```

## Usage

**Horizontal and vertical** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/separator/basic.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Separator } from '@/ui/components/separator';

export default function SeparatorBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <h4 className="text-sm font-medium leading-none">Atlas design system</h4>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Tokens, components and docs for every product.</p>
      </div>
      <Separator className="my-4" />
      <div className="flex h-5 items-center gap-4 text-sm">
        <span>Docs</span>
        <Separator orientation="vertical" />
        <span>Changelog</span>
        <Separator orientation="vertical" />
        <span>Roadmap</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
